notes.title: Update 1.12 – More Optimizations
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900373/53f6330d69e52dccd51879e19cbd7cd95c597cd4.png"][/img][/p][p]I have been able to optimize out another 300Mb.  Additionally, the tutorial bug that some folks have been experiencing where the ghost refuses to manifest has been fixed.[/p][p]See details of the patch below:[/p][p]·       Corrected tutorial bug, where ghosts would stop manifesting and not let player progress.[/p][p]·       After the Camcorder step in the tutorial, the ghost is set to level 3.[/p][p]·       Optimized more UI textures.[/p][p]·       Auto Detect Graphic Settings is more sensitive and will recommend lower settings than previously.[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.11 - Bug Fixes
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900373/8889721ae3ffd5346d62bb403231a3a8011a6e8f.png"][/img][/p][p]See details of the patch below:[/p][p]Some items listed below were corrected after patch 1.10, but were not mentioned in the patch notes for 1.10. So, they are included below.[/p][p] [/p][p]•            Added an icon on the map to show Stephanie's location.[/p][p]•            Added widget on puzzles to inform player how to exit.[/p][p]•            Corrected bug that would get players stuck in the puzzle.[/p][p]•            Corrected bug where UI from the puzzles would get stuck on the players screen.[/p][p]•            Corrected bug where tutorial widget about provocations would appear multiple times.[/p][p]•            Corrected Typos in the Tutorial.[/p][p]•            Optimized camcorder code to improve function.[/p][p]•            Optimized more textures.[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.10 - Interface Update
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900373/fa4152a82cb14ff11034128a9208a4fcb537e84e.png"][/img][/p][p]See details of the patch below:[/p][p]·       Implemented three Volume Sliders in the Settings Menu (Master, Character, and Ghost).[/p][p]·       Optimized more UI textures.[/p][p]·       Improved controller support for UI.[/p][p]·       Revised several Tutorials improving clarity based on feedback.[/p][p]·       Removed the ability to access bookshelves’ UI when they are moving.                                 [/p][p]·       Corrected bug where all archives would show up after Conrad call.[/p][p]·       Corrected bug in Family Tree that would crash tutorial.                                                           [/p][p]·       Corrected bug where subtitles would get stuck on screen.                                                       [/p][p]·       Added collisions for the ghost in the basement to prevent it from leaving its area.[/p][p]·       Increased Best Around Achievement time to 3.5 in game hours.[/p][p]·       Corrected bug in tutorial where ghost would get stuck in place.               [/p][p]·       Corrected bug where camera would take multiple photos in the Performance Hall[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.09 - Optimized Textures
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900373/1de61cb6e94078242568a34597834fa8c270505d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]See details of the patch below:[/p][p]•	Adjusted hit boxes on elevator gates.[/p][p]•	Decreased main menu music volume.[/p][p]•	Corrected Typos[/p][p]•	Improved UI texture quality.[/p][p]•	Audio now plays when game does not have focus (Tabbing Out).[/p][p]•	Revised tutorials.  Specifically added time to when events would occur compensating for lower end systems[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update 1.08 - New Ghost Summary
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900373/4b9892c935cb9513749adf261d30f1b70ea7efa9.png"][/img][/p][p]See details of the patch below.[/p][p]•	Reduced the probability of the owls screeching.[/p][p]•	Modified camera code to minimize the likelihood of duplicate photos.[/p][p]•	Revised and simplified Investigation Summary Page.[/p][p]•	Added Laptop Icon on map to better locate Base Camp.[/p][p]•	Removed Stephanie's ability to speak normal voice lines when spooked.[/p][p]•	Reduce the number of generations on Fallen Apple available in the tutorial.[/p][p]•	Rotate is now "Q" and "E".[/p][p]•	Relics cannot be interacted with until the player has reached that point in the tutorial.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch Version 1.07
notes.content:
See the details of the patch below:
•	Reduced size of popup tutorials.
•	Corrected bug where backpack would stay on floor when exiting the game with it spawned.
•	Optimized textures.
•	Added Inverted-Y axis.
•	Adjusted Archives to be interactable immediately after the call with Conrad.
•	Corrected bug where sometimes Stephanie's backpack would disappear from her back.

notes.title: Patch Version 1.06
notes.content:
See the details of the patch below:
•	Corrected some bugged achievements.
•	Adjusted ghost behavior with doors.  They won't play with them as long.
•	Corrected bug where only one ending could only be selected without deleting the save file.
•	Adjusted lighting throughout but major changes at Base Camp and the Dining Room.
•	Backpack Tutorial will disappear if up while opening the Backpack.
•	Laser Pen points straight forward until you set it down.
•	Revised Tutorial to only show the immediate step required.
•	Revised scoring for Camcorder.
•	Optimized textures.

notes.title: Patch Version 1.05
notes.content:
See the details of the patch below:
•	Corrected typos
•	Connected second floor walkway at base camp so players can cross from wing to wing.
•	Corrected bug where articles would stay on screen if opened when passing out.
•	Stephanie will stop mentioning the archive photo once it's uploaded.
•	Added tutorial for Jacob's Ladder when first incurring different ghost types at max level.
•	When players pass out, they lose two hours of time.
•	Fixed bug causing inventory to disappear when picking up items and entering the backpack at the same time.
•	Corrected bug where players would get locked out of tablet when holding mouse buttons.
•	Balanced Ghost audio.
•	Corrected a bug in the tutorial when using the EMF-POD where the obrs would not show up.

notes.title: Patch Version 1.04
notes.content:
Details of this patch are below.

•	Adjusted map to navigate between floors.
•	Adjusted Archive so chapter 1 is open by default.

notes.title: Patch Version 1.03
notes.content:
The details of what was corrected in this patch are below.

•	Corrected additional soft lock issues that would occur when pressing drop button.
•	Corrected soft lock issue when in manager mode on devices and pass out.
•	Corrected tutorial issue where ghost will not spawn as expected for equipment testing.
•	Nerve refills twice as fast now.
•	Corrected bug where game would crash while investigating the tower rooms.

notes.title: Patch Version 1.02
notes.content:
Below are the details of what was fixed on this patch.

•	Corrected bug in the tutorial when ghost would not appear using the laser light.
•	Adjusted laser light's yellow color to be more noticeable.
•	Enhanced robustness of assets loading in as desired.
•	Corrected menus to support additional resolutions.
•	Corrected bug where the camera and camcorder details would not show up on screen.

notes.title: Patch Version 1.01
notes.content:
•	Corrected several soft lock issues that would occur when pressing drop button.
•	Corrected by removing blank spots on equipment when in the backpack, which would cause the mouse to "unrecognize" the object.
